scope: LLaVA-OneVision Qwen2 7B: best observed completed prefix200 runs for each video dataset and method, not universal optimal settings.

source_implementation.status: LLaVA four improved methods are still not integrated into current KVRepack; table rows reference the historical port implementation.

selection_policies.NExTQA: Maximize recorded WUPS (already 0-100); require effective sample count200.
selection_policies.VATEX: Maximize arithmetic mean of raw fractional BLEU-4/METEOR/ROUGE-L/CIDEr; all display values may multiply by100 together. This follows original tuner selection, not CIDEr-only selection.
selection_policies.VideoChatGPT: Maximize arithmetic mean of five 0-5 metric means; require counts200/200/200/200/100, same response model gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17, no cross-output judge-cache reuse. The 100 consistency units pair the200 consistency question rows.
selection_policies.comparability: 64 frames, budget ratio0.10, BUDGET1024 for all selected runs. Limit200 is the recorded experimental prefix, not the full benchmark population.

alpha_audit.policy: alpha in best_records and inventories is effective alpha; nominal_alpha retains historical path labels. Both selected SnapKV deterministic bests come from truealpha runs.

warnings: Best means best among located completed comparable candidates, not a global optimum or held-out parameter search.
The vatexbest text in VideoChatGPT output directories is only a historical label; VideoChatGPT rows are selected using their own independent five-metric scores.
Shared-prompt/paired-cache full200 scores are retained in a separate inventory and excluded from independent ranking.
All LLaVA improved-method rows are historical source-port records and are not runnable by the current KVRepack launcher until that port is migrated.
No GPU/model run, API call, judging, download or repository modification was performed; this report only reads existing metadata and score artifacts.
K-similarity ablations from later July/August are a separate method family and excluded.
